interpretation.type_admissible: 8/68 have no immediate layer/type blocker. This proves type-domain eligibility only, not exact semantic or empirical correctness.
interpretation.positive_controls: Explicit COMPARISON+DISTINCT candidate records are constructed for K versus Gamma and C versus E_exp. They use only frozen v2 vocabulary and preserve frozen source argument order; independent blind semantically exact FULL is not claimed.
interpretation.semantic_limits: 25 relations occur in seven precommitted challenge families. No challenge category is declared globally impossible on the basis of enumerated vocabulary alone; contrastive independent reconstruction and exact formal carrier validation remain to be done.
interpretation.manuscript_scope: These self-targets are mostly methodological/meta-scientific claims, not direct cognitive-system role events. A claim-carrier direct binding gap does not establish a missing L_sys role or higher architecture layer.
